sloka: तेषामाज्ञाय वचनं रामो वचनमब्रवीत् ।एवं निबोध वचनं सुहृदां धर्मचक्षुषाम् ॥ २.१११.२२॥
transliteration: teṣāmājñāya vacanaṁ rāmo vacanamabravīt ।evaṁ nibodha vacanaṁ suhṛdāṁ dharmacakṣuṣām ॥ 2.111.22॥

translations.english: Having understood their words, Rama said to him, 'Listen to the words of our friends who have a righteous vision.'
